versions.content: XML Configuration of properties (upper multiplicity greater than 1, primitive type or enum or association) Upper multiplicity of property > 1 and type of property is primitive or enum or association: • xml.roleWrapperElement = true Note: upper multiplicity of property > 1, according to MSR-TR-CAP wrapper required • xml.roleElement = true • xml.typeWrapperElement = false Note: roleWrapperElement is true, no additional wrapper required • xml.typeElement = false Note: the content model of each type which occurs more than once needs to be encapsulated in an XML-element. Either the roleElement or the type- Element can be chosen. For Primitives, we chose the roleElement since the MetaModel does not use subclassing for primitives.
